title: He wanted to master the sword in one day

lines.tts: [intrigued] He wanted to master the sword. In one day.
lines.text: He wanted to master the sword. In one day.

lines.tts: [eager, loud] Sensei! Teach me everything. Today!
So he swung ten thousand times.
lines.text: So he swung ten thousand times.

lines.tts: [dry] By sunset... he couldn't lift a chopstick.
lines.text: By sunset... he couldn't lift a chopstick.

lines.tts: [calm, amused] Tomorrow, swing just once more than today.
lines.text: Tomorrow, swing just once more than today.

lines.tts: Day one. One percent better. Nobody notices.
lines.text: Day one. One percent better. Nobody notices.

lines.tts: [dry] Day thirty. Still... kind of bad.
lines.text: Day thirty. Still... kind of bad.

lines.tts: [building] But one percent, every single day, stacks up.
lines.text: But one percent, every single day, stacks up.

lines.tts: [impressed] Day three hundred sixty-five. Thirty-eight times better.
lines.text: Day three hundred sixty-five. Thirty-eight times better.

lines.tts: Not one heroic day. Just a lot of boring ones.
lines.text: Not one heroic day. Just a lot of boring ones.

lines.tts: [eager, loud] Sensei! Day three hundred sixty-six! One percent more!
lines.text: Sensei! Day three hundred sixty-six! One percent more!
